notes.title: Update 0.2.14 - Cinematic Intro and Level 3 - The Catacombs Added!
notes.notes: This is a big, exciting update! You can now explore the catacombs, and face the evils, therein! Also, check   out that new cinematic trailer!

notes.title: 0.2.8 More bug fixes, Improved boss fight
notes.notes: Fixed a lot of things in this patch. Bugs is hatin life.

notes.notes: The fight with the Queen was broken and she wasn't doing any damage. Fixed! Fixed a few other things as well.

notes.title: Update 0.2.6
notes.notes: This update fixed a few minor bugs. Next I will get Deck of Darkness live on Linux/SteamOS. Once again, please forgive any bugs!

notes.title: Early Access official release.
notes.notes:
Hello all! This updates the game to the early access version. My release this morning was the same as the demo since it had already been approved for release. Thanks for checking out my game! If you'd like to join my sleepy little discord, come on by: https://discord.com/invite/XqMe7Vdrhy
Please forgive any *ahem* bugs, but this baby is fresh out of the demonic womb! I will be trying to publish at least small updates a few times a week as we go.

We got hundreds of wishlists during Next Fest. Thank you for that! Thanks to anyone who supports indie game development!

Stay tuned!

Morgan
